headline: Deconsolidation gain inflates profit; guidance raised
summary_short: Honeywell Technologies reported Q2 FY2026 consolidated sales of $9.72B, up 4.3% y/y, while GAAP diluted EPS of $17.83 was inflated by a $6.63B one-time pretax gain on deconsolidating Quantinuum following the June 29 Aerospace spin-off and 1-for-2 reverse stock split; adjusted diluted EPS was $4.52, down 4% y/y.
summary_long: Sales rose 4% y/y to $9.72B (4% organic) on a $38B backlog, with consolidated segment margin up 30bp to 23.1%. Building Automation sales grew 9% organically on fire and services strength; Process Automation fell 1% organically on lower catalyst volumes; Industrial Automation sales fell 5% reported (up 4% organic) ahead of pending PSS/WWS divestitures. GAAP diluted EPS of $17.83 reflects a $6.63B one-time gain on deconsolidating Quantinuum following the June 29 Aerospace spin-off and 1-for-2 reverse stock split (317M shares, down from ~634M); adjusted diluted EPS fell 4% to $4.52. Cash was $8.75B, capex $315M, free cash flow $1.25B (+43% y/y). FY2026 guidance raised: sales to $19.8-20.0B, organic growth 3-4%, segment margin 20.1-20.5%, adjusted EPS to $8.05-8.35 from $7.90-8.30.
